name: Gosha Suzuka
source: Granddaughter of Gosha Kanji, the current head of the Gosha family known for their dealings with outsiders. Suzuka is an intelligent and mature young woman, standing in contrast to her grandfather's non-confrontational stance. She is Rikugou Suzune's sister.
